verdict.rationale: Recurring automation is a fair axis for a design platform, but the evidence pack documents no scheduling capability. The sketchtool CLI, JavaScript plugin API, sketch:// URL scheme and local MCP server are building blocks a user could drive from an external scheduler. None of them is a product-provided recurring job or workflow schedule, and a one-off command is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
